svg.title: Combined daily AI token usage
svg.desc: 40,781,240,381 tokens across 185 active dates. 2026-02-04 to 2026-09-30. Darker blue means more tokens. Gray means no recorded usage; it does not establish zero usage. Calendar weeks start on Monday.

g.text: Recorded usage · includes cached input · unrecorded dates are not assumed to be zero
